name: 3D Dioramas
description: A creative agent builds photorealistic dioramas live from a sentence: ground, buildings, trees, trains and people take shape one after another, with tilt-shift, macro or 50 mm optics and natural light.
capabilities: Fully by voice: "create a diorama of a Japanese station with cherry trees" and it opens full screen by itself
Spontaneous: when you talk about a train, a building or a place, Nuxiva can show a small animated diorama by itself (can be turned off)
Live building: elements appear layer by layer while the agent works
Catalog of 27 elements: railway, architecture, vegetation, furniture, people and free volumes
Photographic look: tilt-shift, macro and 50 mm, golden hour, overcast, blue hour, noon, night
Edits in plain words: "add a cherry tree on the left", "make it sunset", "remove the bench"
Also works without an available brain through fallback compositions
While idle it studies conversations about visual topics, designs new elements by itself and adds them to the catalog (removable)

settings.NUXIVA_DIORAMA_LEARN: New catalog elements learned while idle
